episodes.title: From Spiritual Teacher to Cult Leader | How I Created a Cult
episodes.description:
From Spiritual Teacher to Cult Leader | How I Created a Cult
Season 1 Episode 1

To watch How I Created A Cult Season 1👉 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBanCY2ops6g

Andrew Cohen promised spiritual freedom—but former followers describe a community where devotion became pressure and trust gave way to control.

In the opening episode of How I Created a Cult, Cohen and former members recount the powerful spiritual experiences that drew people to his teachings. What began as a search for enlightenment and belonging gradually became a way of life centred on one leader, with followers sacrificing relationships, careers and personal independence.

Through interviews and archival recordings, the documentary explores the growing hierarchy, public criticism and intrusion into private decisions within the community. Former followers reflect on the impact on their families, while Cohen acknowledges mistakes in his teaching and the suffering they caused.

Where does spiritual guidance end and control begin?

How I Created a Cult explores spiritual teacher Andrew Cohen’s rise and the experiences of former followers who describe how a promise of enlightenment became a system of devotion, manipulation and control.
